After saving, it automatically calls `\Core\ImageProcessor::makeWebpSibling()`. ```php // Standard upload call — WEBP sibling is created automatically $result = imageUpload($UPLOAD_DIR_CLIENTS, $_FILES['thumb_image']); $saved = $result['saved']; // e.g. "6830abc.png" — DB stores this, foo.webp created alongside // If you add a NEW upload path that bypasses imageUpload(), call manually: move_uploaded_file($tmp, "$dir/$filename"); \Core\ImageProcessor::makeWebpSibling("$dir/$filename"); // Deletion — imageDelete() handles sibling cleanup automatically imageDelete("$UPLOAD_DIR_CLIENTS/$saved"); // removes .png + .webp ``` Rules: - Do not add image resize/convert logic outside `Core\ImageProcessor`. - `makeWebpSibling()` is silent on failure — never throw from it. - Convertible: `jpg`, `jpeg`, `png`, `gif`.
